name: files
label: Files
tagline: Browse, copy, move and preview your files

help.about: Browse your files: copy, move, rename, preview them and open archives.

manifest.summary: A file manager: browse, copy, move, rename, trash (never delete), restore, extract and compress, with thumbnails and a preview pane.

features.name: Browse
features.description: Sidebar places and drives, breadcrumb with typed paths, back/forward/up, list and grid views, sort, name search, hidden files.

features.name: Change files
features.description: Copy/cut/paste and drag and drop as background jobs with a progress bar, rename, new folder, move to trash (gio trash only) and restore from the trash.

features.name: Archives
features.description: Extract here and Compress to .zip with bsdtar, with a progress percentage counted per entry.

features.name: Preview
features.description: Image, video, audio and text preview pane; thumbnails for images, videos and PDFs.

features.name: Folder watch
features.description: The open folder redraws by itself when something is added, removed or renamed in it, keeping selection, scroll and thumbnails; a folder that vanishes falls back to the one above.

features.name: Drag in and out
features.description: Files dropped from outside Forge are copied in (file:// links as a copy job, otherwise uploaded with progress); rows dragged out carry file:// links for other apps.

features.name: More windows
features.description: Ctrl+N, the bar's New window button, middle-click on a folder or place, or a folder's menu opens another native Forge window of Files, each with its own folder and history; drag between them to copy.

known_gaps: Folders dropped from outside are refused with a message; drop the files inside them.
Restore only covers the home trash, not .Trash-1000 on other drives.
Desktop drag in/out is checked with synthetic events in headless Chrome only, not yet inside the WebKitGTK Forge window.
New windows need a Forge restart after 2026-10-24 (forge.py and forge_popout.py changed); before it, Ctrl+N does nothing inside Forge.
